messages:
mika: opened a small PR to fix wording about rate limits vs quotas and to add a migration snippet for customers moving from header-based quota to the new tiered metering API. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/748

laura: nice, this has been a frequent question from support. Can we add a before/after example for the header vs new body field?

mika: good call. adding both python and cURL. also adding a short note about dashboard panel renaming (we renamed some panels during the analytics refactor).

ajay: for SDK snippet, show how people can set per-request metadata to preserve upstream quota tags. e.g. `response = client.requests.create(..., metadata={"quota_tier":"enterprise"})` and then show reading `response.metadata.quota_applied`

sam: also ensure we clarify billing: "earmarked quota tags do not create billing exceptions; they map to usage buckets used by billing rules". customers keep asking if tagging affects price.

mika: added sentence and short example config for proxies to forward `X-Redwood-Tier` header -> `metadata.quota_tier` mapping.

docs-bot: PR #748 updated: added before/after snippets and updated dashboard links (CI: 44D)

laura: small nit: in the python snippet change `quota_tier` to `quota_tier_id` to be consistent with the SDK naming. pushed that change.

mika: thanks. also added a short migration checklist at the bottom for customer success: 1) identify current header usage 2) update proxy to send metadata 3) verify mapping in staging 4) update dashboards to use `quota_tier_id` tag.

sam: sounds good. i'll merge after quick doc-lint.

mika: doc-lint passed. merging now. :ship: 

docs-bot: PR #748 merged by sam (deploy preview available).
